- **Max Verstappen** won the Canadian Grand Prix [1].
- **Lewis Hamilton** won the Belgian Grand Prix [2] and the British Grand Prix [5]. He is counted once.
- **Lando Norris** won the Dutch Grand Prix [3].
- **Carlos Sainz** won the Australian Grand Prix [4].

The documents cover only five of the 2024 rounds, so this count covers only those races. Other 2024 winners may exist in races not listed here.
